about: Every requirement sentence this repository and issue #35 held on 2026-09-22, plus three written from omamori issues, each labelled with the form its sentence says (or neither) before the first request, and with who wrote it: tool (this project, for its fixtures and benches), model (the requirement-writing model's first output, repaired — bench/corpus), text (read by hand from a real issue or pull request), written (from an issue's text, for this measurement). `run.ts verify` checks each sentence against the file it names.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If generating a session's automatic title fails, the failure must reach the caller as an error. It must not return a successful result with no label.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If loading the root node or rewriting tree heights fails while a restore is being finalized, the failure must reach the caller as an error. It must not be discarded and the restore reported as finished.

sentences.text: If setting the base root key fails while a chunk is being restored, the failure must reach the caller as an error. The restorer must not carry on as though it had succeeded.

sentences.text: If serializing a tool call's result to JSON fails, the failure must reach the client as an error. It must not return a successful response with empty content.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If parsing a transaction, querying the database, or encoding a value or a certificate fails, the failure must reach the caller as an error. It must not skip the item that failed and return a successful result.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If reading the type of a directory entry fails while the build inputs are collected, the failure must reach the caller as an error. It must not drop the entry and return a successful result.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If resolving a recurring job's concurrency constraint fails, the failure must reach the caller as an error. It must not enqueue the job without the constraint and report success.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If downloading or decoding an external snapshot or mutation blob fails during app state sync, the failure must reach the caller as an error. It must not return a successful result that leaves the blob's mutations empty.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If reading state to answer a gRPC request fails, the failure must reach the caller as an error. It must not be swallowed and answered as though the value were absent.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If flushing, syncing or setting the permissions of a credential file fails during an atomic write, the failure must reach the caller as an error. It must not return a successful result.

sentences.label: failure_propagation

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If decoding a value fails, the failure must reach the caller as an error. It must not be folded into a default value that is reported as the profile.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If reading an existing integrity baseline fails, the baseline-loading operation must return an error to its caller. It must not return a successful result saying that no baseline exists.

sentences.label: failure_propagation
sentences.text: If reading an existing configuration file fails while checking whether a rule override disables a rule, that check must return an error to its caller. It must not return a successful result saying that the rule is not disabled.
